links.comparator_used: Full manual first-pass screening of all records by humans (estimated effort; locked blinded human consensus in the audit)
links.outcome: First-pass screening effort and missed relevant records in systematic review title/abstract screening
links.effect: Estimated first-pass effort fell from 415 to 34 person-days; 63,858 of 74,679 records (85.5%) were placed in the AI-excluded pool; 0 of 600 sampled AI-excluded records were confirmed false negatives; in the 680-record audit all 38 final retained records had been AI flagged, whereas blinded human consensus missed seven.
links.tradeoff: Imperfect sensitivity (98.0% on the selection benchmark, 96.7% on topic-matched validation); the approach relies on audit of AI-excluded records, human oversight and programme-specific monitoring.
links.quote: Prospective deployment screened 74,679 records, placed 63,858 (85.5%) in the AI-excluded pool and reduced estimated first-pass screening effort from 415 to 34 person-days.

design_hint: audited LLM triage with locked models, human audit of excluded records, and programme-specific monitoring
